template.name: Outfit selection — Decipher
template.description: Five native design-file outfit tasks with a shared presentation and static image dataset.
template.instructions: Use OutfitSelection once in the main slot for the five-task outfit exercise. Supply label (a valid unique Decipher loop label; the example uses OutfitRounds). The base template contains the shared CSS/JS, dataset and native .dat loader exactly once. The component contains native assignment, an automatically submitted initialization page, and five repeated native category questions. Preserve autosave=1, the initialization page, native row conditions/validation and guarded Continue. Preserve the bundled private outfit-design-v2.dat system file and the 24 public SVG assets using their exact filenames. Do not randomize offers in JavaScript, invent a replacement design, drop offered-ID fields, change choice codes, duplicate the shared hooks, add branded headers/footers, or use Save/collection language. Keep only the concise research question/instructions, task progress, outfit interaction and Continue. Shirt, pants and shoes are required; hat defaults to explicit No hat code 0. This is a fixed synthetic example, not a statistically optimized conjoint. The component has fixed native child labels and one DOM instance, so use exactly one exercise per survey on its own pages. To change dataset/design/wording, update the base/native source and the corresponding files together, then recompile and verify native data before fielding.
